items.why: Hands decisions to outside investors: a poor fit for almost any community.
Legal contracts to settle disputes are rare outside formal organizations.
Admitting members by lottery is rare; it suits a few cases, e.g. citizens' panels or housing co-op places.
Settling disputes by chance is rare; it suits a few cases, e.g. juries drawn by lot.
